title: Week 29 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “inflation”?
options: A structured presentation in which a student answers questions and justifies methods and conclusions.
A sustained rise in the general price level, reducing money’s purchasing power.
Testing a claim by comparing it with independent evidence.
A tax intended to align private incentives with an external social cost.
questions.explanation: Inflation means a sustained rise in the general price level, reducing money’s purchasing power.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “consumer price index”?
options: The value of the best alternative forgone when a choice is made.
The quantities consumers are willing and able to buy at different prices during a stated period.
A measure of average price change for a defined basket of consumer goods and services.
Legislative review of executive agencies, programs, spending, and implementation.
questions.explanation: Consumer price index means a measure of average price change for a defined basket of consumer goods and services.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “unemployment rate”?
options: A market in which one firm supplies a product without close substitutes and entry is blocked.
The principle that legitimate political authority depends on the people’s authorization.
The quantities producers are willing and able to sell at different prices during a stated period.
The unemployed actively seeking work as a percentage of the labor force.
questions.explanation: Unemployment rate means the unemployed actively seeking work as a percentage of the labor force.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “labor force participation rate”?
options: Rapid withdrawals driven by fear that an institution cannot meet obligations.
The labor force as a percentage of the civilian noninstitutional working-age population.
A good that can replace another good in consumption or production.
A union in which member states retain substantial sovereignty and the central authority is limited.
questions.explanation: Labor force participation rate means the labor force as a percentage of the civilian noninstitutional working-age population.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “recession”?
options: A system combining markets with public regulation, provision, taxation, and social insurance.
An opponent or critic of ratification who feared centralized power and demanded stronger protections for liberty.
A significant, broad decline in economic activity lasting more than a brief fluctuation.
A cost or benefit imposed on a third party and not fully reflected in a transaction price.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “business cycle”?
options: A facially neutral practice producing unequal effects, which has different legal significance under different statutes.
Gains from exchange lost when policy or distortion prevents mutually beneficial transactions.
Recurring expansions and contractions in aggregate economic activity.
The power to determine whether government action is consistent with the Constitution.
questions.explanation: Business cycle means recurring expansions and contractions in aggregate economic activity.

questions.question: Which action best demonstrates mastery of the Week 29 inquiry?
options: A student distinguishes the price level from the inflation rate and interprets unemployment together with labor-force participation.
A student accepts the first available claim or offer without checking the source, terms, evidence, or consequences.
A student relies on political identity, advertising, or personal preference as a substitute for documented analysis.
A student selects an answer only because it sounds confident, even when the record is incomplete or contradictory.
questions.explanation: A student distinguishes the price level from the inflation rate and interprets unemployment together with labor-force participation.

rubric: 5 points: clear claim, accurate disciplinary reasoning, two specific pieces of evidence, meaningful qualification or counterargument, and complete explanation.
